2513570.steps:
1) Configure a new interface X2 , zone: WAN
2) Edit this interface in IPv6 interface page, select the ip-assignment as DHCPv6, enable PD,
enable "Send preferred delegated prefix" and set the value as 2001:470:80B7:930::/60
3) connect it to a DHCPv6 server, make sure it can acquire PD from this server;
4) capture dhcpv6 packet and check if append the IP Prefix option in the IA-PD option to indicate it’s hint
5)Switch to "Protocol" tab, check the info under "Delegated Prefixes Acquired via DHCPv6" table.

2513575.steps:
1 open console to configure interface ipv6 X2  follow below CLI commands
config(AAA)# interface ipv6 X2

(edit-interface[X2]-ipv6)# ip-assignment dhcpv6

(edit-WAN-dhcpv6[X2])# prefix-delegation

(edit-WAN-dhcpv6-pd[X2])# preferred 2001:470:80b7:906:: 60          

(edit-WAN-dhcpv6-pd[X2])# COMMIT

% Applying changes...

% Status returned processing command:

COMMIT

% Changes made.  

2 show interface ipv6 X2 check if PD hint saved
interface ipv6 X2
    ip-assignment dhcpv6
        prefix-delegation
            preferred 2001:470:80b7:906:: 60
            exit
3 from GUI check the PD hint value
4 Switch to "Protocol" tab, check the info under "Delegated Prefixes Acquired via DHCPv6" table.
2513575.title: Enable PD Hint via CLI
2513575.result: the values should be same as what be set in hint
